system.description:
You come from a clan that has produced many Jedi, and you have overcome your Species' impulsiveness by becoming a master of The Force.

Prerequisites: Twi'lek, Force Sensitivity

Effect: Your Wisdom score is considered to be 4 points higher for the purpose of determining how many Force Powers you gain from the Force Training Feat, granting you two extra Force Powers for each Force Training Feat.
